newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Sri Lanka Jan-Oct tea crop up 5 pct to 211 mln kg.
newsitem.headline: Sri Lanka Jan-Oct tea crop up 5 pct to 211 mln kg.

text.p: Black tea output in Sri Lanka, the world's leading tea exporter, rose nearly five percent to 211.1 million kg in the 10 months to October from 201.4 million kg a year ago, the Tea Board said on Thursday.
Output for October rose 31 percent to 22.8 million kg from 17.4 million kg in the same month last year, it said in a statement.
The Indian Ocean island's highgrown tea crop in the January-October period fell slightly to 59.3 million kg from 60.3 million kg a year ago.
Production of low growns, popular with Russian and Middle eastern buyers, rose to 112.4 million kg from 99.4 million kg a year earlier, the board said.
Sri Lanka, whose tea exports are expected to hit a record 250 million kg this calendar year, satisfies about 20 percent of world demand. - Colombo newsroom (941-434319)
